- Renamed `RefreshTokenService` to `SessionService` and updated all references. - Replaced `refresh_tokens` table with `sessions` table, adding metadata fields (IP, user agent, device info). - Updated Prisma schema to reflect the new `Session` model. - Refactored authentication flow to use sessions for token creation, verification, and revocation. - Added support for session cleanup with metadata logging for improved traceability and security.
